summary: Maintain explicit traceability links from requirement to design, API, schema, tests, and tasks (spec-kit style task tracing or a lightweight traceability matrix) and walk the links as a change-impact checklist on every requirement change.

evidence.summary: GitHub Spec Kit: Specify->Plan->Tasks->Implement workflow; spec is the contract/source of truth for agent work; integrates 30+ agents as of 0.11.0 (2026-06).
ADRs create a single durable source of truth per decision; decision log links to PRs/issues for traceability.
